reading.body:
This Verizon facility in Sandy City, Utah has not published its power capacity or IT specifications. The site is mapped and confirmed by street address, but the operator does not maintain a public specification page for this location the way colocation providers do.

Utah has 21 mapped data center facilities, of which 9 have published power figures totaling 52.18 MW. This facility ranks tenth by published capacity in the state, which means eight facilities with known specs are larger and at least one with a published figure is smaller or equal.

Without published megawatt capacity, IT load, or cooling specifications, this campus cannot be assessed for its role in AI infrastructure scaling. Verizon operates this site as an internal network facility rather than as a wholesale colocation service, and has not disclosed whether it hosts accelerator workloads, what power it consumes, or whether it has headroom for growth.
